pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā bhikkhūnaṃ anekapariyāyena vinayakathaṃ katheti vinayassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati vinayapariyattiyā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati ādissa ādissa āyasmato Upālissa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.4: bhagavā kho anekapariyāyena . . . Upālissa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.5: handa mayaṃ āvuso āyasmato Upālissa santike vinayaṃ pariyāpuṇāmā 'ti, te ca bahū bhikkhū therā ca navā ca majjhimā ca āyasmato Upālissa santike vinayaṃ pariyāpuṇanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.6: atha kho chabbaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.7: etarahi kho āvuso bahū bhikkhū therā ca . . . pariyāpuṇanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.8: sace ime vinaye pakataññuno bhavissanti amhe yen' icchakaṃ yadicchakaṃ yāvadicchakaṃ ākaḍḍhissanti parikaḍḍhissanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.10: atha kho chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhū upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vadenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.11: kiṃ pan' imehi khuddānukhuddakehi sikkhāpadehi uddiṭṭhehi. yāvad eva kukkuccāya vihesāya vilekhāya saṃvattantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.13: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū vinayaṃ vivaṇṇessantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.14: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave vinayaṃ vivaṇṇethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.17: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā vinayaṃ vivaṇṇessatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.18: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.19: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:1.20.1: yo pana bhikkhu pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadeyya: kiṃ pan' imehi khuddānukhuddakehi sikkhāpadehi uddiṭṭhehi, yāvad eva kukkuccāya vihesāya vilekhāya saṃvattantīti, sikkhāpadavivaṇṇake pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:2.1.6: uddisante vā uddisāpente vā sajjhāyaṃ vā karonte.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:2.1.8: kiṃ pan' imehi khuddānukhuddakehi sikkhāpadehi uddiṭṭhehi . . . saṃvattantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:2.1.9: ye imaṃ pariyāpuṇanti tesaṃ kukkuccaṃ hoti vihesā hoti vilekhā hoti, ye imaṃ na pariyāpuṇanti tesaṃ kukkuccaṃ na hoti vihesā na hoti vilekhā na hoti, anuddiṭṭhaṃ imaṃ varaṃ, anuggahitaṃ idaṃ varaṃ, apariyāpuṭaṃ idaṃ varaṃ, adhāritaṃ idaṃ varaṃ, vinayo vā antaradhāyatu ime vā bhikkhū apakataññuno hontū 'ti upasampannassa vinayaṃ vivaṇṇeti, āpatti pācittiyassa. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:2.2.1: upasampanne upasampannasaññī vinayaṃ vivaṇṇeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:2.2.5: anupasampannassa vinayaṃ vā aññaṃ vā dhammaṃ vivaṇṇeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc72:2.3.2: na vivaṇṇetukāmo iṅgha tvaṃ suttante vā gāthāyo vā abhidhammaṃ vā pariyāpuṇassu pacchā vinayaṃ pariyāpuṇissasīti bhaṇati,
